overall_goal: Transfer the cooked aubergine to a paper towel-lined plate to absorb excess oil

goals.description: Prepare a plate with a folded paper towel
goals.rationale: The person sets down a plate, tears off a piece of paper towel, folds it, and places it on the plate to absorb oil.

goals.description: Transfer the cooked aubergine from the pan to the plate
goals.rationale: The person moves the cooked aubergine from the frying pan onto the paper towel-lined plate and taps the spoon to dislodge any stuck pieces.
